name: PROJECT HOPE - THE PEOPLE-TO-PEOPLE HEALTH FOUNDATION INC

grants.description: Solicitation for a cooperative agreement for USAID Empowered Communities Activity with a total estimated USAID budget of $35 million over four years. The estimated start and end date of the activity is from October 1, 2023, through September 30,2027. The initial obligation amount will be $4,820,000.
